data.name: LignoCarbon
data.description: LignoCarbon Schweiz AG is a Swiss biochar producer in Illnau-Effretikon, founded in 2020 as a subsidiary of timber company ZürichHolz AG. It operates a wood-chip pyrolysis plant producing EBC-certified biochar for agriculture, animal feed, soil improvement, and concrete additives, with waste heat fed into a district heating network.
